caption:
Part 2 of Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, as translated into English at the time (excerpts; Part 1 is the opening). Read by a synthetic voice with a vintage-radio effect, not Mussolini's. Music: Verdi, La forza del destino overture, Toscanini, 1944 (public domain). No freely licensed photos of this exact speech exist in the archives checked; these public-domain photos are from Feb.-Aug. 1941 and are dated on screen.
